modelingNotes: Exact Murrelektronik article85087; historic source manufacturer Murr is preserved. Manufacturer exact-product diagram establishes 1=PE,2=N,3=L,4/5=DC− and6/7=DC+. Diagram numbers are retained rather than connector-local table indices.

Adjustable output and universal/variable input are capability ranges. No input/output nominal_voltage or conditional current scalar is assigned. Output ratings are total supply capability, not independent allowances on duplicate clamps. Project intent must specify the chosen supply voltage.

Input pins1/2/3 are required for the powered abstraction. Output connections are application-dependent. No field bond to DC return is invented. The device outline is not a wire; function membership never creates net continuity.

Two explicit factory paths4–5 and6–7 are shown in the exact manufacturer diagram. Front restart/shutoff plug link exists but its contact inventory and selectable paths remain undocumented. Preserve partial coverage and invent no configuration pins or fixed selector bridge.

Input185–265 VAC; the source125–300 VDC claim is not established for85087. Output24–28 VDC,20 A subject to temperature/approval conditions. Do not infer DC-input use or a universal24 A rating from a catalog boost/UL field.

Clamp technology and installed manufacturing revision must be checked against the physical device; exact current diagrams do not prove every historical unit revision. No housing/mounting bond path is inferred from metalwork.

connectionCoverage.notes: Seven documented field terminals and two output common paths. Front restart/shutoff selector contact inventory and any distinct conductive attachment interface remain unresolved; no extra pins or automatic bond are invented.
